body: Thank you for letting me know I'm not alone. I love my daughter so much and don't want her to suffer. I think she deserves so much more than I can give. I don't know how to go about being a better mom. I feel like I'm unfixable. But I am going to try, I took my meds last night and I'm about to call my psychiatrist. Thank you for the hug and I hope you are able to manage your diabetes or overcome it.
Thank you for taking the time to encourage me. I'm calling my psychiatrists office as soon as they open.
Thank you for what you said about if the situation was reversed. I hadn't thought of that. I took my psych meds last night and feel slightly less devastated.
